Overview

About the Data Center Building Block Solutions (DCBBS)

Supermicro Data Center Building Block Solutions (DCBBS) package everything needed to build a liquid-cooled AI data center: compute, storage, networking, racks, liquid cooling, power, management software and professional services.

Racks and clusters are integrated and tested at rack level (L11) or cluster level (L12) before shipping, which shortens the time from delivery to production.

Complete data center

From individual GPUs and switches to full racks, site infrastructure and services.

L11/L12 validation

Rack and cluster testing before shipment for turnkey deployment.

DLC-2 liquid cooling

Up to 40% lower electricity cost and up to 20% lower TCO.

Warm-water operation

45 °C inlet water reduces chiller and water use.

Management software

Infrastructure and cluster management included.
